main_sections.section_name: PHM Benchmark: Scenario Design and Dataset Curation
main_sections.description: THE MAIN CONTRIBUTION SECTION - Explain the systematic process to arrive at 75 scenarios. Focus on PROCESS not destination. This is where we tell the scientific story of scenario creation.

subsections.subsection_name: Scenario Categorization: Mapping to PHM Core Tasks

Show diagram/figure mapping the 4 categories as superset
Explain your 5 sections: Engine Health Analysis → Condition Monitoring; Fault Classification → Fault Diagnosis; RUL → Fault & RUL Prediction; Cost-Benefit + Safety → Maintenance Scheme
Justify WHY these 4 categories vs other knowledge-based approaches
Identify organizational stakeholder levels: Executive level, Site engineering level, Asset management level
Explain who asks which questions and why (personas)
subsections.storytelling_notes: This is scientific justification for your categorization choices. Reference PHM-Bench figure. Explain the decision-making hierarchy in industrial organizations.

subsections.description: Explain the filtering process from broad dataset landscape to focused, curated collection

section_4_expanded_outline.title: Section 4 is THE KEY CONTRIBUTION - The Benchmark Creation Story
section_4_expanded_outline.narrative_flow: Literature establishes 4 PHM categories → We adopt and map our work to them → We start with broad dataset landscape → Progressive curation to 18 datasets → SMEs formulate queries following specific rules → Ground truth prepared systematically → Evaluation criteria defined → Final statistics analyzed
section_4_expanded_outline.key_message: We followed a rigorous, systematic, expert-driven process to create a high-quality benchmark. Every step had a protocol, every choice had justification, every scenario was validated.
section_4_expanded_outline.comparison_to_existing: Like MLE-Bench (handcrafted, progressive curation) + IndustryEQA (SME validation, human filtering) + PHM-Bench (PHM-specific categories) but uniquely combining all three approaches
